easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
